purpose: Controlled resource scaling of complete joint outcome-count model, no inference or NLP claim
generator: PCG64(seed + N + 100*M + T); base MxN then candidate TxN iid Uniform(0,1). Fixed cutoff .5; mean pooling; selected base mean >=.5; exact explicit replacement flips. Nominal k=max(1,round(.30*N)); alpha=.10; all selected rows retained in optimization; no subsampling.
backend: SciPy milp / bundled HiGHS; forwarded threads=1, random_seed=0, presolve=True, mip_rel_gap=0
one_seed_per_grid_point: descriptive stress grid, not independent NLP replication
concurrent_load: Original frozen tolerance experiment continues; elapsed times are load-dependent, not backend-speedup evidence
peak_memory: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss bytes on Darwin; independent child per target, includes imports, scores, model and solver
